project set \\u003Cproject\\u003E --backlog linear is accepted only when the project has a Linear team bound or the same command binds one, and is refused otherwise naming h9k project set \\u003Cproject\\u003E --linear \\u003CTEAM\\u003E; BacklogPolicy gains Linear, its parse error names all four values, and the decider\\u0027s closed set admits it\u0022,\u0022h9k project set judges the resulting pair: clearing the team with --linear none while the policy stays linear is refused naming h9k project set \\u003Cproject\\u003E --linear none --backlog none; refusing a github-issues or jira policy on a Linear-bound project is the base card\\u0027s rule and is not repeated here\u0022,\u0022With the policy linear, h9k task publish on a draft that carries no linked issue and has no publication pending refuses before publishing with the three existing choices: link one with h9k task link-linear, attest none exists with --no-existing-item, or skip tracking with --untracked; the refusal names Linear and the link-linear command\u0022,\u0022With the policy linear, h9k task publish --no-existing-item on a task that will create an issue resolves the team through Linear before the publish commits; no Linear connection on this install, a rejected key, no team bound, an unknown team, or Linear not answering each refuses with a non-zero exit, leaves the task a Draft, and names the remedy and --untracked as the way to publish without Linear; --untracked and an already linked task make no Linear call\u0022,\u0022After the publish commits, the publishing install creates the issue itself, with no agent session and no daemon involvement, through one issueCreate carrying the resolved team\\u0027s id, the team\\u0027s defaultIssueState as stateId (omitted only when Linear reports none), the title, and the description, so a team with Triage on does not receive the issue in Triage; no assignee, label, Linear project, or cycle is set\u0022,\u0022The title is the objective folded to one line and cut to 255 characters, and the description is GitHubIssueBody.Compose\\u0027s output: the agent context without the discovery-workspace pointer IdeaPromoteCommand appends, the acceptance-criteria checklist, and the full objective when the title was cut\u0022,\u0022h9k task publish --linear-team \\u003CTEAM\\u003E names the team for this one publish in place of the project\\u0027s default, is accepted only with --no-existing-item on a task that will create an issue, is refused anywhere else as having nothing to do, and is checked by the same pre-commit step\u0022,\u0022The created issue is read back and linked through the internal link step h9k task link-linear uses, which applies no adoption-state rule, and under the policy linear the task record is written to the ledger on every outcome: linked, create failed, link failed, already linked, and --untracked\u0022,\u0022Under the policy linear, on a publish that creates an issue, the go signal from --queue or the interactive offer is appended only after the link attempt, so dispatch never cuts a branch before the key exists; when no issue was linked the task stays published and not queued, and the output names how to link it and then h9k task queue \\u003Ctask\\u003E\u0022,\u0022Publishing with --untracked publishes with no Linear issue, records the choice on TaskPublished as it does for Jira and GitHub, and the note names Linear; a task adopted or linked earlier publishes without creating anything\u0022,\u0022Publish never files a second issue for one task: a task that already carries a reference or a pending publication creates nothing, and the create is sent once and never retried by the platform; a read-back or link failure after Linear returned an identifier names h9k task link-linear \\u003Ctask\\u003E \\u003Cidentifier\\u003E; a definite refusal (a GraphQL errors array, success false, or a 4xx response) names a by-hand create and then the link; an unknown outcome (a timeout, a lost connection, a 5xx, or an unreadable answer) says the issue may exist and names searching the team before linking or creating\u0022,\u0022The --backlog-routing setting is ignored under the linear policy, and h9k project set says so whenever a command touching --backlog or --backlog-routing leaves the project with the policy linear and routing text set\u0022,\u0022h9k project show renders the linear policy as its own row rather than as none; h9k task show on a task past Draft under the policy linear, with no linked issue and no untracked attestation, says no Linear issue is linked and names h9k task link-linear; the help text for --backlog, --no-existing-item, and --queue and the backlog section of docs/cli.md describe the linear policy\u0022,\u0022Every Linear call in these tests runs against recorded responses; a test pins the exact issueCreate request for a sample task, stateId and the absence of assigneeId included; the tracking step takes its Linear client and its ILedger as parameters, so the outcome tests in criteria 8, 9, and 11 run on FakeLedger and the existing Postgres fixture, with no git ledger write, no GitHub call, and no new container\u0022]},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022BlockedBy\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Type\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Model\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022RevisedAt\u0022:\u00222026-10-30T12:49:40.154061\u002B00:00\u0022,\u0022RevisedByOwnerId\u0022:\u002201a00d41-5a50-7368-b048-72bcfee948bf\u0022,\u0022EpicId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022QueuePriority\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageComposition\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ReviewStageCompositionAcknowledged\u0022:false,\u0022ClearInteractiveMode\u0022:false,\u0022StackedOnTaskId\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022StackedOnPullRequestNumber\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022CloseLinkedIssue\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022SpikeKind\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022ExitCriterion\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Constraints\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022Effort\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false}}","originEventId":"408bb64f-ce10-48e1-98a9-565dd4c4449a","originSequence":145528,"originNodeId":"01a00d41-5b80-753d-a3f1-070b25e490e4","originOwnerRootFingerprint":"c8f5c85900dac9911ce1ada43484dc7bf91a2a3e86efa8812d9f84cfd25bf2ac","originAt":"2026-10-30T12:49:40.164449+00:00","originProjectId":"01a00d41-5d9a-73cc-b648-af431f721a71"},{"streamId":"01a18cd2-dd3e-7625-81bb-f3c294049b01","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskRevised","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a18cd2-dd3e-7625-81bb-f3c294049b01\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:false},\u0022AgentContext\u0022:{\u0022hasValue\u0022:true,\u0022value\u0022:\u0022Pre-flight
